title: Precast concrete (manufactured under plant control conditions).
officialText:
The minimum specified concrete cover for pre-
stressed and nonprestressed reinforcement, ducts and end fittings in precast concrete manufactured under plant control
conditions shall comply with ACI 318, Section 7.7.3.
